newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepali premier to visit Pakistan in November.
newsitem.headline: Nepali premier to visit Pakistan in November.

text.p: Nepali Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba will visit Pakistan in November, the Nepalese foreign ministry said on Tueday.
The ministry said the five-day visit, beginning November 1, follows an invitation from Pakistani Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto.
"We are thinking of giving a new dimension to the economic cooperation between the two countries," a foreign ministry spokesman told Reuters. He did not elaborate.
During his trip Deuba is expected to visit Karachi, Pakistan's business capital, and invite Pakistani investors to the Himalayan kingdom, officials said.
